h1: Vasidtee City Hotel — a light-on-the-wallet city stay with easy parking
intro: If you want a place to sleep in central Suphan Buri without spending much, close to everything, with easy parking · Vasidtee City Hotel is a budget 3-star many people reach for — a brightly coloured block on Nen Kaeo Road, near the hospitals and the city centre · the appeal is straightforward: a central location, free parking and rates from around ฿800/night · it is not a riverside resort or a luxury boutique, but for a well-placed room at an easy price, it is a regular pick for business travellers and people visiting the town.

body.html: Vasidtee City Hotel sits at 64/31 Nen Kaeo Road, Tha Phi Liang, Mueang Suphan Buri — right in town, a few minutes' drive to the city centre and its restaurants · it has been open since 2014 and is a 79-room property whose most recognisable feature is its bright, colourful design inside and out, looking more modern than many same-price hotels in the city · note that some platforms now list it as Capital O 75514, the brand that took over management, but it is the same building and location.

Rooms earn praise for being clean and cheerfully designed · each has AC, a flat-screen TV, a fridge, drinking water and an en-suite bathroom with a hot shower · the rooms are compact but comfortable for one or two people · guest reviews broadly agree it suits short stays, business trips or a base while exploring the city more than a long resort-style holiday.
"Clean room, cute colourful design, right in town so food is easy to find, parking is convenient and the price is low — perfect for a night or two on business."

Another thing self-drive travellers like is the hotel's free parking, which is easy to get in and out of · there is also an on-site restaurant, and at times extra services such as a massage room and karaoke · the central location makes getting around easy — Suphamit and Porchai hospitals are within walking distance, and Banharn–Jaemsai Tower and Chaloem Phatra Rachini Park are under 2 km away.

Worth knowing before you book: rooms are fairly compact and have no balcony, and some rooms are dimly lit · a few reviews mention the hot water temperature being inconsistent and breakfast options being limited (some rates are booked without breakfast, so check first) · there is no pool or garden, so it fits a city stay rather than a resort break · a few reviewers note a musty smell in certain corner rooms, so it is worth viewing the room first if you walk in.

Vasidtee's location suits people who plan to stay mainly in central Suphan Buri · if your plan is to explore the town, browse the markets, visit Banharn–Jaemsai Tower or run errands and want a well-placed room at a gentle price, it delivers · but if you are set on Bueng Chawak or Sam Chuk Market, which are in other districts, allow plenty of extra driving time.

The honest verdict from real reviews: Vasidtee City Hotel is a city hotel that is good value for short stays — good location, free parking, bright design and clean rooms · don't expect spacious rooms or resort-style facilities, but for a central spot at a budget price, it is a practical, easy-to-find choice.

honestSummary: Vasidtee City Hotel is a city hotel with a good location and good value for short stays — clean, brightly designed and with free parking · it suits people set on staying in central Suphan Buri or travelling on business more than those wanting spacious rooms or resort-style facilities.
honestChecks: If you want a spacious room or a relaxing atmosphere — rooms here are compact, with no balcony, pool or garden → a suburban resort would fit better.
If you are mainly heading to Bueng Chawak or Sam Chuk Market — both are in other districts and require a fair bit of driving → consider a stay closer to those attractions.
If breakfast matters to you — some rates are booked without breakfast and the menu isn't varied → check the booking conditions and plan to eat out in town.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Vasidtee City Hotel

faq.q: Where is Vasidtee City Hotel · is it in central Suphan Buri?
faq.a: It is at 64/31 Nen Kaeo Road, Tha Phi Liang, Mueang Suphan Buri — right in the city centre, near hospitals and the restaurant area · Banharn–Jaemsai Tower and Chaloem Phatra Rachini Park are both under 2 km away, so getting around town is easy.

faq.q: What are Vasidtee City Hotel's starting prices · what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿800/night for a Standard room · Superior is about ฿1,000 and Deluxe about ฿1,300 · prices vary by season and platform, and some rates may not include breakfast — always compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Why do some sites list it as Capital O 75514?
faq.a: Vasidtee City Hotel is now managed under the Capital O brand, so some platforms show it as Capital O 75514 Vasidtee City Hotel · it is the same building and location, not a different hotel.

faq.q: Who is Vasidtee City Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits people staying in central Suphan Buri or travelling on business · good location, free parking, bright design and budget prices · it is less suited to those wanting spacious rooms, a pool or a relaxing resort atmosphere.

faq.q: Does the hotel have parking · does it allow pets?
faq.a: Yes, there is free hotel parking with easy access — a point self-drive guests often praise · pets, however, are not allowed.
